entries.fac6e50afcd4edab: Looking ahead to 2030, when it will mark its 130th anniversary, the company aims to remain a company that supports Japan's food and agriculture. Its policy is to work on establishing and strengthening its earnings base through a review of its sales strategy that makes use of its strengths, namely its customer base, sales network and one-stop provision of plants and machinery, and to explore growth areas, including R&D of new products and new fields that meet labor-saving and manpower-saving needs and the identification of order opportunities in Southeast Asian markets.
entries.fc5d2ee592afbc99: Looking ahead to 2030, when it will mark its 130th anniversary, the company aims to remain a company that supports Japan's food and agriculture. Its policy is to work on establishing and strengthening its earnings base through a review of its sales strategy that makes use of its strengths, namely its customer base, sales network and one-stop provision of plants and machinery, and to explore growth areas, including R&D of new products and new fields that meet labor-saving and manpower-saving needs and the identification of order opportunities in Southeast Asian markets. The company is also advancing proposals for labor-saving and automation systems that combine 'monozukuri' (manufacturing) and 'digital' by leveraging the technology of Dejisain Co., Ltd.
